name: 4c
description: zig-zag barrier, two 70 mm gaps; the upper block is jammed in its corner, only the lower one can be pushed clear
notes: gaps 70 mm between the walls' faces (vine 48.5 mm, block 98 mm); both bends are 90 deg corners with a block flush in them, 2 mm clear. Box 1 (upper) is in the corner that opens toward the start, so any push drives it into a wall; box 0 (lower) is in the corner on the goal side, so the vine grows through the lower gap and pushes it out
